description: This file defines a validation rule class 'TimesheetDeletedEntriesParamRule' used for validating entries related to deleted timesheet entries in the OrangeHRM Time plugin API. The class extends an abstract validation rule and implements a method to validate the structure and data types of input entries, ensuring they contain required fields with proper values.

classes.name: TimesheetDeletedEntriesParamRule
classes.description: Validation rule for ensuring entries related to deleted timesheet entries are correctly structured with valid project and activity IDs.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the input entries array contains entries with exactly two fields, both of which must be numeric and greater than zero for projectId and activityId.
